## Runs 6–7 — `sdh-spot-check` at D = 0: n = +3.2×10¹² (run 6, B 0 → 10 T) and n = −1.2×10¹² (run 7, 10 → 0.3 T)

Raw |Rxx|(B), Rxx(1/B) with the minima marked (labels = ν from the run-5 density, whose absolute scale is still the geometry prior), and the SdH FFT in 1/B over 2–10 T (cubic B-space background), against F_L = n h/4e for a single 4-fold Fermi surface. **Read — run 6 (electron):** oscillations from ≈ 1.6 T and Rxx → 0 (≤ 4 Ω) minima already at 1.85 T — well-formed Landau levels, high mobility; zeros at 1.85, 1.99, 2.45, 2.71, 3.24, 3.72, 4.30, 5.91, 6.08, 7.15 T. Above 7.5 T Rxx climbs to ≈ 500 Ω (structured plateau 8.4–9.0 T, ν_cal ≈ 15) and drops toward 10 T (ν_cal 13.2). The minima are **not** periodic in 1/B — paired zeros (1.85/1.99, 2.31/2.45, 5.91/6.08) say more than one Landau ladder is present. FFT: 7.5 T dominant with 15 / 22.5 / 30 T — a comb consistent with harmonics of 7.5 T, but `sdh_onset` also tracks 31.3 T independently; F_L(cal) = 33.1 T. Two readings fit equally in 1D: (i) two sub-bands F_light ≈ 7.5 + F_heavy ≈ 30 T (Bernal-like pair; their sum 37.5 T vs F_L 33.1 T would mean the density scale is ~12 % low), or (ii) one ladder whose Rxx → 0 zeros generate the harmonic comb. **Run 7 (hole):** oscillations from ≈ 1.6 T; minima at 1.68, 2.04 (→ 0), 2.74, 3.38, 4.14, 4.92, 6.00, 6.96, 8.36 T with the 1/B spacing shrinking from 0.105 to 0.024 T⁻¹ toward high B — the ν step between successive minima falls (4 → 2 → 1-like), i.e. symmetry-broken integer states emerging at high B and/or interleaving with region B's ladder (there n_B ≈ −0.77×10¹²); R rises monotonically above 8.4 T to 590 Ω at 10 T (ν_cal = 5, entering the low-ν regime). FFT: 5.0 and 12.5 T (F_L(cal) = 12.4 T). **Take:** T_e permits SdH from 1.5 T; Rxx maxima ≤ 590 Ω at |n| ≥ 1.2×10¹² (sizes the fan sensitivity); the ladder/mosaic ambiguity is a 2D question — the Landau fan (plan step 4) separates region-B lines (parallel, offset in n) from a second sub-band (different slope) and fixes the absolute n scale from the line slopes.

"""sdh-spot-check read, runs 6 (n = +3.2e12) and 7 (n = -1.2e12), D = 0 (run-5 cal): raw R(B), R(1/B) + minima, onset, FFT vs F_L."""
import warnings
from scipy.signal import find_peaks, savgol_filter
warnings.simplefilter("ignore")

RUNS = {6: +3.2e12, 7: -1.2e12}     # cm^-2 (run-5 cal, region A; absolute scale = geometry prior)
FS = 50e-6 / 10e-9                  # sr1 50 uV at 10 nA -> 5 kOhm full scale
fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(14, 11))
for k, (rid, n_cm2) in enumerate(RUNS.items()):
    r = run(rid)
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X") / r.meta["measurement_config"]["sr0_gain"]
    R = np.abs(r.col("sr1_X") / 1.0 / I); Tm = r.col("T_sample")
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R, I, Tm = B[o], R[o], I[o], Tm[o]
    n_si = abs(n_cm2) * 1e4; F_L = float(luttinger_frequency(n_si))
    print(f"=== run {rid}: n = {n_cm2/1e12:+.1f}e12 -> F_L = {F_L:.1f} T; I_bias {np.median(I)*1e9:.2f} nA; |R| {R.min():.1f}-{R.max():.0f} Ohm; "
          f"T_sample {Tm.min():.3f}-{Tm.max():.3f} K; nu(10 T) = {n_si*cst.h/(cst.e*10):.1f}")
    sel = B > 1.5; Rs_ = savgol_filter(R[sel], 7, 2); Bs_ = B[sel]
    mins, _ = find_peaks(-Rs_, prominence=8); maxs, _ = find_peaks(Rs_, prominence=8)
    nu_min = n_si * cst.h / (cst.e * Bs_[mins])
    print("  minima B/R/nu_cal: " + ", ".join(f"{b:.2f}/{rr:.0f}/{v:.1f}" for b, rr, v in zip(Bs_[mins], Rs_[mins], nu_min)))
    print("  1/B spacing of minima (1/T): " + ", ".join(f"{d:.3f}" for d in -np.diff(1 / Bs_[mins])))
    try:
        on = sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=0.5, r_full_scale=FS); print(on.summary())
    except Exception as e:
        print("  sdh_onset:", type(e).__name__, e)
    f, sp = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(2.0, B.max()), nfft=2048, bg_degree=3, log=False); sp = sp[0]
    m = f > 2; pk, _ = find_peaks(sp[m], prominence=0.1 * sp[m].max())
    print(f"  FFT (2-10 T, dF {1/(1/2.0-1/B.max()):.1f} T) peaks: " + ", ".join(f"{ff:.1f} T" for _, ff in sorted(zip(sp[m][pk], f[m][pk]), reverse=True)[:5]))

    ax = axes[0, k]; ax.plot(B, R, lw=0.8); ax.plot(Bs_[mins], Rs_[mins], "rv", ms=4); ax.plot(Bs_[maxs], Rs_[maxs], "g^", ms=4)
    ax.set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("|Rxx| (Ohm)"); ax.set_title(f"run {rid}: n = {n_cm2/1e12:+.1f}e12, D = 0 — raw |Rxx|(B), sr1 50 uV (FS {FS:.0f} Ohm)")
    ax = axes[1, k]; s2 = B > 1.0; ax.plot(1 / B[s2], R[s2], lw=0.8); ax.set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax.set_ylabel("|Rxx| (Ohm)")
    for b, v in zip(Bs_[mins], nu_min):
        ax.axvline(1 / b, color="r", lw=0.4, alpha=0.5); ax.text(1 / b, R[s2].max() * 0.95, f"{v:.0f}", fontsize=6, ha="center", color="r")
    ax.set_title("Rxx vs 1/B — red: minima, label: nu from run-5 n (scale uncalibrated)")
    ax = axes[2, k]; ax.plot(f, sp / sp[m].max(), lw=0.8); ax.set_xlim(0, 80); ax.set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("FFT amp (norm)")
    ax.axvline(F_L, color="k", ls="--", lw=0.8, label=f"F_L = {F_L:.1f} T (full n, 4-fold)")
    for frac in (0.5, 0.25): ax.axvline(F_L * frac, color="gray", ls=":", lw=0.7)
    ax.legend(fontsize=7); ax.set_title("SdH FFT in 1/B, B in (2, 10) T, cubic B-space background")
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`), B slow 1.5 → 10 T, n fast −1.25 … +3.25×10¹²

> **05:27** · landau-fan D=0: B slow 1.5->10 T step 0.1 (86 rows, lead-in from 0 T); fast (Vtg,Vbg) co-swept along run-5 D=0 line, n -1.25..+3.25e12 (129 pts, 0.035e12/pt); fast\_delay 1 s, slow\_delay 3 s; sr1 200 uV (20 kOhm FS); leak trip 1 nA; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~10:57** (≈5h30m)

Plan step 4 (`hera_scratch/plan.md`) — the stacking measurement the operator asked for. The 1D spot checks (runs 6–7, ana) show well-formed Landau levels from ≈ 1.6 T (Rxx → 0 zeros at 1.85 T on the electron side) but minima that are not periodic in 1/B: either two sub-bands (a Bernal-like light/heavy pair) or the series-mosaic region B (Δn = +0.43×10¹²) interleaving its ladder — undecidable in 1D. In the (n, B) plane those separate: Rxx minima run along lines of constant ν = n h/eB through the origin; a second region gives the **same** slopes offset along n, a second sub-band gives **different** slopes and LL crossings. The low-ν sequence at high B (ν = ±4, ±8, ±12 …) reads the zero-LL degeneracy (16-fold for ABCA, two crossing ladders for ABAB, a Dirac-like ±2, ±6 sequence for ABCB), and the line slopes fix the absolute density scale that run 5 left at the geometry prior. **Design:** field is the expensive axis (0.137 T/min) → B slow, 1.5 → 10 T in 0.1 T (86 rows), starting where the magnet sits (0 T after the handoff; the 1.5 T lead-in is 11 min) and ending at 10 T; fast axis = (V_tg, V_bg) co-swept along the run-5 D = 0 line (D_offset −0.013 V/nm), n = −1.25 … +3.25×10¹² in 129 points (0.035×10¹² per point, ≈ 10 mV TG steps) — at 2 T a Δν = 4 line spacing is 0.19×10¹² ≈ 5–6 points, at 10 T 0.97×10¹² ≈ 28 points. **Coverage trade:** the hole side stops at n = −1.25×10¹² (TG −0.3 V limit) → ν ≥ −5 at 10 T only; the electron side reaches ν = +13 at 10 T, +52 at 2.5 T. D ≠ 0 is not covered here (step 5 candidate). `fast_delay` 1.0 s (τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB → ≈ 1-point lag, as in the run-5 map), `slow_delay` 3 s after each flyback. **Sensitivity** sr1 200 µV = 20 kΩ FS: runs 6–7 maxima ≤ 590 Ω at |n| ≥ 1.2×10¹²; the ν = 0 column at high B may exceed 20 kΩ and soft-clip — that reads as "≥ 20 kΩ, insulating", itself evidence — while metallic minima keep ≈ 0.75 Ω resolution. Leak guard 1 nA on both Keithleys (baselines −100 / +25 pA). **Price** (run-5 rate 1.17 s/pt → 1.2 s/pt with two gates): 86 × (129 × 1.2 s + 44 s ramp + 3 s settle + 3 s slow_delay + 2 s flyback) ≈ 4.95 h + 11 min lead-in ≈ 5.2 h; realistic 5 h 30 m. Ends at **10 T** with gates at n = +3.25×10¹² — the next step rides the magnet down. **Checkpoints:** first row (~14 min in: signal, sensitivity, both gate currents, gate readbacks tracking the D = 0 line), then every ~15 rows a re-formed partial fan (straight lines through the origin? region-B offset lines? broad rail?) — abort if sr1 rails across a wide band of the metallic side or a gate current leaves its baseline.

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`): B slow 1.5 -> 10 T (0.1 T, 86 rows); (Vtg, Vbg) co-swept along the calibrated D = 0 line, n = -1.25 .. +3.25e12 (129 pts) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, absolute scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.25, 3.25, 129)                       # 1e12 cm^-2; step 0.0352e12 (TG ~10 mV)
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = np.round(np.asarray(Vtg_vec, float), 5), np.round(np.asarray(Vbg_vec, float), 5)
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_vec.min() and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_vec.min() and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, \
    (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max(), Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
_nchk, _Dchk = calc_nD(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert np.abs(np.asarray(_Dchk)).max() < 1e-3, "D = 0 line round-trip"
B_vec = np.round(np.arange(1.5, 10.0001, 0.1), 3)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and len(B_vec) == 86
print(f"fast: {len(n_vec)} pts along D = 0, n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} .. {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 (step {n_vec[1]-n_vec[0]:.4f}); "
      f"Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f} .. {Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V, Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f} .. {Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V")
print(f"slow: {len(B_vec)} rows, B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, step 0.1 T")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B| < 0.05: handoff left the magnet at 0), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"gates now (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}) V, PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

I_TRIP = 1e-9
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 3.0
# Fixed sensitivity 200 uV = 20 kOhm FS at 10 nA: runs 6/7 maxima <= 590 Ohm at |n| >= 1.2e12. The nu = 0 column at high B may
# exceed 20 kOhm and soft-clip (reads as ">= 20 kOhm: insulating" - informative); metallic minima keep ~0.75 Ohm resolution.
sr1.sensitivity(200e-6)
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (FS {sr1.sensitivity()/10e-9:.0f} Ohm at 10 nA), tau {sr1.time_constant()} s, slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB; "
      f"fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s; magnet settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan D = 0: B slow {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T (0.1 T, {len(B_vec)} rows); (Vtg, Vbg) co-swept along D = 0, "
                  f"n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} .. {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts, run-5 cal); sr1 200 uV; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY}, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY}")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 fan: B slow {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T step 0.1 ({len(B_vec)} rows); fast (k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt) co-swept along D = 0: '
              f'n = {n_vec[0]:+.2f} .. {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 cm^-2 ({len(n_vec)} pts); Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f}..{Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f}, Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f}..{Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V; '
              f'cal run 5: c_tg {CAL["c_tg"]:.3e} F/m2, ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f} V/nm; sr1 200 uV')
# gates to the first fast point before the 1.5 T lead-in ramp (each later row flies back to it)
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, float(Vbg_vec[0])); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, float(Vtg_vec[0]))
interruptible_sleep(5)

# row layout: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, k_tg.curr); s.plot(k_tg.volt, k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.4f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec], slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
# ends at 10 T with the gates at the last fast point (n = +3.25e12) - no park; the next step rides the magnet down.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}) V, T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")
